question: Under what condition may a teacher grant the teaching for long life?
premises: The teacher must thoroughly examine the recipient
Examination is to be done always or carefully
Only then may the teacher give what grants long life
inference: After thorough examination, a teacher may give the teaching that confers long life
uncertainties: cirajīvitam may refer to long life or a related boon
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one may give to him that which brings long life.
